name: Iruyana Hyul
source: A dark elf who stalks a specific island in the archipelago, Iruyana indiscriminately attacks any who stray into his territory. When he finds his prey, he falls into a berserk frenzy and derives sadistic pleasure from the dismemberment of his unfortunate victims.
